تستذهنون (form X)
# تَسْتَذْهِنُونَ (tastaḏhinūna) /tas.tað.hi.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
# تُسْتَذْهَنُونَ (tustaḏhanūna) /tus.tað.ha.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
